title: OL-20261118-1: Remaining quniverse assets: zones, 39 KV keys, spinoffs, mail-relay, tenant-ps-edge/mail, R2 ultrastable-git
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** after 00:00 UTC daily and when the registrar lock ends 2026-11-20
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation singleaccount --check
**Status:** open

SINGLE-ACCOUNT-1. Zones ultrastable.io/.app/.net/.org are registered with Cloudflare Registrar in quniverse (locked); ultrastable.net zone is staged pending in the ultrastable account (id 8e9333ac...) with DNS copied; the nameserver switch needs go-ahead. 39 KV keys wait on the free-plan write limit. R2 needs enabling in the ultrastable account dashboard. Workers ultrastable-spinoffs, ultrastable-mail-relay, tenant-ps-edge, tenant-ps-mail move after the zones. Nothing was deleted in quniverse.
